text: Pottery studio layout for the community newsletter. Clay feeds Wheel3, and Wheel3 feeds Kiln. Connect Kiln to Shelf5 with a dotted line. Make Kiln red. Is there any blue shape? Move Shelf5 below Kiln. Which shape is the leftmost?
Pool sits at the center of Deck1. Bar2 should be right of Pool. Connect Deck1 to Deck2 and Deck2 to Pool. Make Bar2 teal. Is Deck2 near Bar2? Show me all the teal shapes. Count the arrows.
Make Sail white. Sail is huge.

Rug is the first thing kids see, so put Rug at the center. Chair6 should be above Rug. Shelf6 sits beside Chair6. Connect Rug to Chair6 and Rug to Shelf6. Make Shelf6 brown. Which shape has the most connections? Describe the reading corner.
Buzzer is the center of the game. Connect Team5 to Buzzer and Team6 to Buzzer. Make Buzzer yellow. Is Team6 linked to Team5? Which shape has the fewest connections? Undo that.
Wall2 should be left of Tower9. Catapult is a huge gray triangle. Moat goes around Wall2, so connect Moat to Wall2. Make Tower9 orange. Is there any square? Which shape is the rightmost?

I'm building the volunteer shift board for the food bank, and it needs to be easy for everyone to read. Coordinator sits at the top, so put Coordinator at the top. Shift1, Shift2 and Shift3 go in a row under the Coordinator, so arrange them in a row. Volunteer is the person on the shift, so connect Volunteer to Shift1, Shift2 and Shift3. Snack should be below Shift2, so move Snack below Shift2. Make Snack orange and make Volunteer green. Is Shift3 reachable from Coordinator? Which shape has the most connections? Describe the board for the volunteers. Rename Snack to Break. Duplicate Shift1 once for the evening crew. Count the arrows on the board. Show me all the green shapes. Undo the last connect if the shifts look wrong. Thanks, the first shift starts Monday.
A1 and B1 are both red squares. Connect A1 to B1. Make C1 blue. Is C1 directly linked to A1?
Fort is a huge white square. Snowman should be near Fort. Sled goes left of Snowman. Connect Fort to Sled. Show me the list of white shapes. Which shape is the farthest from Fort?
Connect Chop to Fry and Fry to Serve. Make Serve red. Is Serve reachable from Chop? Put Plate4 below Serve. Redo that.
Cashier stands at the bottom right. Shelf7 and Shelf8 should be left of Cashier. Connect Cashier to Exit5. Make Exit5 gray. Is there a cycle? Describe the store. Duplicate Shelf8 once.
Delete Pen7.
Barn sits at the top. Goat and Pig are both near Pond2. Connect Barn to Goat and Barn to Pig. Make Pond2 blue. Is Pig reachable from Goat? Show me all the blue shapes.

We're making a simplified cockpit panel diagram for the flight school, and the instructors want the layout simple. Display goes at the center of the panel. Altimeter, Radar and Autopilot should be in a row, so arrange them in a row. Throttle sits left of Display, so move Throttle left of Display. Warning must be above Display, so put Warning above Display. Connect Display to Altimeter, Radar and Autopilot. Make Warning red and make Throttle green. Is there any blue shape? Which shape is the leftmost? Describe the panel for the students. Rename Radar to Sonar. Duplicate Altimeter once for the backup gauge. Count the arrows on the panel. Show me all the red shapes. Undo the last arrange if the row is wrong. Thanks, the first class is on Monday.
Ticket feeds Gate6, and Gate6 feeds Usher. Make Usher blue. Which shape has the most connections? Describe the queue.
From now on, circles are purple. Make Dye1 a circle. Dye2 is a small yellow square. Is there any purple shape? Forget the rule about circles. Count the shapes.
Bread3 is right of Cake3. Cookie should be below Bread3. Connect Cake3 to Cookie with a dashed line. Make Cookie brown. Is Cookie left of Bread3? Describe the shelves.

Connect Turbine1 to Substation, Turbine2 to Substation, and Turbine3 to Substation. Make Substation gold. Is there a path from Turbine1 to Turbine3? Which shape is the least connected? Describe the farm. Duplicate Turbine2 once. Count the arrows.
Lamp3 is tiny. Make Lamp3 yellow.
Laptop2 and Phone2 both sync to Drive. Connect Laptop2 to Drive and Phone2 to Drive. Backup should be below Drive. Make Drive teal. Is Backup connected to Laptop2? Which shape is the least connected?

We're preparing the lighting plot for the spring play and the crew needs every spot labelled. Stage4 is the main area, so put Stage4 at the center. Spot4 should be above Stage4, and Spot5 should be right of Spot4. Backdrop sits at the back, so move Backdrop below Spot4. Desk5 is the lighting desk, so connect Desk5 to Cue. Connect Cue to Spot4, Spot5 and Stage4 so every cue fires. Make Backdrop gray and make Spot5 yellow. Is there any red shape? Which shape is the topmost? Describe the lighting plot for the crew. Label Desk5 as Board. Duplicate Spot4 once for the spare. Rename Cue to Trigger. Count the arrows in the plot. Show me all the yellow shapes. Undo the last connect if the cue order is wrong. Thanks, the first rehearsal is on Monday.
Hull is at the bottom of the ship. Mast sits on Hull. Sail2 should be above Mast. Connect Hull to Cannon. Make Cannon gray. Is Sail2 reachable from Hull?
Index links Word1 and Word2. Make Word1 green. Is Word2 bigger than Word1? Undo the last change. Describe the index.
Pond3 has Fish2 and Fish3 in it. Connect Pond3 to Fish2 and Pond3 to Fish3. Make Fish3 orange. How many shapes are not orange?
Arrange the poses in a column, then distribute them vertically. Make Pose4 purple. Which shape is the bottommost? Redo that.
Station9 is the hub. Connect Rail1 to Station9 and Rail2 to Station9. Yard is below Station9. Make Yard gray. Is Yard reachable from Rail1? Which shape is the farthest from Rail2?
From now on triangles are red. Make Glass2 a triangle. Make White2 white. Is there any green shape? Show me all the red shapes.

Our neighborhood watch wants a simple map before the next meeting, so I'm drawing it now. Hall2 is the meeting place, so put Hall2 at the center. Watch1, Watch2 and Watch3 should be around Hall2, so arrange them in a circle. Church sits to the left of Hall2, so move Church left of Hall2. Park2 is a big green circle. Connect Hall2 to Watch1, Watch2 and Watch3. Make Church gray. Is Park2 reachable from Watch1? Which shape is the farthest from Hall2? Describe the map for the members. Rename Watch3 to Patrol. Duplicate Watch2 once for the new street. Count the arrows on the map. Show me all the gray shapes. Undo the last connect if the lines cross. Thanks, the meeting is on Tuesday.
Moon3 sits between Sun3 and Earth3. Connect Sun3 to Moon3 and Moon3 to Earth3. Make Sun3 gold. Is there a cycle? Show me the list of gold shapes.
Bottle goes into Bin3. Can goes into Bin3 too. Make Bin3 green. Count the arrows. Undo that.

Start2 leads to Climb, Climb leads to Descent, and Descent leads to Finish. Make Finish red. Is there a path from Start2 to Finish? Which shape has the most connections? Describe the trail. Rename Descent to Downhill.
Frame1, Frame2 and Frame3 hang in a row. Bench3 should be below Frame2. Make Frame1 blue. Is there any green shape? Undo the last arrange. Describe the gallery.
Grid feeds Charger, and Charger charges Car2. Make Car2 white. Is Car2 directly linked to Grid? Count the shapes.
Lid2 sits on Jar2. Cookie2 should be right of Jar2. Make Jar2 huge. Is Cookie2 smaller than Jar2? Describe the jar.

I'm drawing the marathon route for the running club, and the organisers want to check the water stops. Start3 is at the bottom left. Mile5 and Mile10 follow after Start3, so connect Start3 to Mile5 and Mile5 to Mile10. Finish3 comes last, so connect Mile10 to Finish3. Water sits between Mile5 and Mile10, so put Water between them. Medic3 should be near Finish3. Make Water blue and make Medic3 red. Is there a path from Start3 to Finish3? Which shape is the rightmost? Describe the route for the club. Rename Mile10 to Halfway. Duplicate Water once for the second stop. Count the arrows on the route. Show me all the blue shapes. Undo the last connect if the route looks wrong. Thanks, the race is in April.
Sandwich and Fruit sit inside the Box2. Connect Box2 to Sandwich and Box2 to Fruit. Make Fruit yellow. Which shape is the closest to Box2? Describe the lunch box.
Up is a large green triangle. Down is a small red triangle. Flat should be between Up and Down. Is there any blue shape? Show me all the triangles.
Connect Monday, Tuesday and Friday to the Weekend. Make Weekend gold. Connect Monday to Tuesday and Tuesday to Friday. Which shape has the most connections? Count the arrows.
Make Noise1 blue. Noise2 is a huge red circle. Is Noise1 smaller than Noise2?

Engine leads the train, so put Engine at the top. Car3 and Car4 follow, so connect Engine to Car3 and Car3 to Car4. Caboose is last, so connect Car4 to Caboose. Make Caboose red. Is there a path from Engine to Caboose? Which shape is the least connected? Describe the train. Duplicate Car3 once. Count the arrows.
Waiting feeds Room8, and Room8 sends Dog3 home. Make Room8 green. Is Dog3 reachable from Waiting? Undo that. Describe the clinic.

I'm writing the setup diagram for the wind tunnel test, and the engineers need every sensor placed right. Wing is in the middle of the tunnel, so put Wing at the center. Probe should be left of Wing and Sensor3 should be right of Wing. Fan3 sits at the far left, so move Fan3 left. Connect Fan3 to Probe, and Probe to Wing. Connect Wing to Sensor3 and Sensor3 to Data. Data sends results to Screen3, so connect Data to Screen3. Make Fan3 blue and make Wing gray. Is Screen3 reachable from Fan3? Which shape is the leftmost? Describe the setup for the engineers. Rename Sensor3 to Gauge. Duplicate Probe once for the second test. Count the arrows in the setup. Show me all the gray shapes. Undo the last connect if the signal path looks wrong. Thanks, the test is next Wednesday.
Berry and Banana2 go into the Blender. Make Blender purple. Connect Blender to Berry. Is Banana2 connected to Berry? Show me the list of purple shapes.
Arrange GK, Defender, Midfield and Forward in a row, then distribute them horizontally. Make GK orange. Which shape is the bottommost? Connect GK to Defender. Count the arrows.
Washer sits left of Dryer. Hamper goes into Washer. Make Sink3 blue. Is Dryer near Sink3? Undo the last set.
Make Hat2 red. Hat2 is huge.
From now on squares are teal. Make Atlas a square. Is Novel teal? Connect Atlas to Poetry. What rules are saved right now?
Pit sits at the bottom. Lap1 leads to Lap2, and Lap2 leads back to Pit. Connect Pit to Lap1 to close the loop. Is there a cycle? Make Pit orange. Which shape is the closest to Lap1?

Our community garden has been growing for years, and the committee wants a clear plan before the spring planting. Plot1, Plot2 and Plot3 sit in a row, so arrange them in a row. Shed2 is at the back, so move Shed2 above Plot2. Path5 runs along the plots, so connect Plot1 to Path5 and Path5 to Plot3. Tap2 is near Path5, so put Tap2 near Path5. Make Shed2 brown and make Tap2 blue. Is Plot2 reachable from Shed2? Which shape is the rightmost? Describe the garden for the committee. Rename Path5 to Walkway. Duplicate Plot1 once for the new bed. Count the arrows on the plan. Show me all the blue shapes. Undo the last arrange if the plots look uneven. Thanks, we plant in April.
Logo2 sits in the center. Make Logo2 gold. Connect Logo2 to Tagline. Is Tagline reachable from Logo2? Describe the poster.
